universe.report: CFTC Legacy Commitments of Traders - Futures Only

current_reports.purpose: Current Legacy Futures Only snapshot verification

historical_compressed.purpose: Official annual historical Legacy Futures Only rows

historical_viewable.purpose: Official report-date archive and period-specific report identity
historical_viewable.important_note: CFTC states that archive dates indicate report date, not release date; period-specific report HTML tested in 2019, 2023, 2025 and 2026 does not expose release date/time metadata.

release_schedule.purpose: Official scheduled publication dates where available

historical_special_announcements.purpose: Official delayed/suspended/catch-up publication dates and corrections

temporal_semantics.report_date: The CFTC position/open-interest reference date shown by the report, normally Tuesday close but not guaranteed to be Tuesday in holiday weeks.
temporal_semantics.scheduled_release: The publication date expected by the CFTC release schedule; this is not sufficient when an official delay/suspension/catch-up announcement supersedes it.
temporal_semantics.actual_available_from: The earliest verified public availability timestamp/date after applying release schedule plus any CFTC delay/suspension/catch-up announcement. Backtest consumption is forbidden before this point.
temporal_semantics.normal_publication_rule: CFTC states that the reports generally use the immediately preceding Tuesday and are generally published Friday at 3:30 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time.
temporal_semantics.same_day_rule: If a release timestamp is verified, use must be strictly after actual_available_from; equality is not eligible.
temporal_semantics.date_only_fallback: If only an actual publication date is verifiable, the observation becomes eligible on the following calendar day. This deliberately sacrifices same-day use rather than inventing a timestamp.

federal_holidays.rule: May shift report reference date, publication date, or both; require official schedule/announcement evidence.

2018_2019_appropriations_lapse.rule: CFTC suspended COT publication after the December 21, 2018 release and later published delayed reports in chronological catch-up order beginning February 1, 2019. Naive Friday availability is forbidden for affected report dates.

2023_ion_cyber_incident.rule: The ION Cleared Derivatives cyber incident prevented timely and accurate submissions to CFTC. COT reports that normally would have been published in February and March 2023 were postponed and issued sequentially as the backlog was validated. Naive Friday availability is forbidden for every affected report date; use requires official CFTC catch-up evidence.

2025_national_day_of_mourning.rule: CFTC announced that offices would be closed January 9, 2025 and that the COT report for that week would be released Monday January 13, 2025. The normal Friday rule is forbidden for the affected report date.

2025_appropriations_lapse.rule: CFTC interrupted COT processing/publication from October 1 through November 12, 2025 and published an explicit catch-up table. Naive Friday availability is forbidden for affected report dates.

corrections_and_revisions.rule: If CFTC announces a correction or revised report, the historical ledger must retain what was knowable before the correction and apply the corrected value only from the correction availability point when the affected field can influence the model. Current corrected history must not be back-propagated silently.

current_repo_assessment.live_runtime_dates_mean: CFTC report/reference dates, not verified publication availability dates
current_repo_assessment.current_builder_temporal_limitation: Updates only the current rolling runtime and does not encode historical actual_available_from per row.
